# Table Test

## Basic Table

| Concept | Meaning |
|---|---|
| Precision | TP / (TP + FP) |
| Recall | TP / (TP + FN) |

## Table with Math

| Metric | Formula |
|---|---|
| MSE | $\frac{1}{n}\sum(y_i-\hat y_i)^2$ |
| Accuracy | $\frac{correct}{total}$ |

## Aligned Table

| Left | Center | Right |
|:---|:---:|---:|
| L1 | C1 | R1 |
| L2 | C2 | R2 |
